_comment: Template mapping for a RapidAPI rentals API. Adjust endpoint, params and field paths to match the API you subscribed to (see its 'Endpoints' tab on RapidAPI). Params support {{location}}, {{minBhk}}, {{maxRent}}, {{page}}. Field paths are dot paths into each result object; arrays can be mapped with 'path[].field'. Empty-string params are dropped.
